sourceSentences: LeBlanc's next damaging champion ability against the marked target will consume the mark to deal the again.
Sigil of Malice and Mimic: Sigil of Malice can detonate each other's marks.
Distortion and Mimic: Distortion have independent return pads and LeBlanc can travel to both while they are active.

If Mirror Image triggers while LeBlanc is tethering to a target with Ethereal Chains (or its Mimic: Ethereal Chains version), her clone will not produce a fake tether, giving away which is the real one.
Using a basic attack breaks the stealth at the end of the attack windup.
forms a tether between LeBlanc and the target for 1.5 seconds, during which they are revealed.
Spell shield will block the tether's application and initial damage but not the aftereffects of one already applied.
Both the initial and the delayed damage can detonate Sigil of Malice.
Ethereal Chains and Mimic: Ethereal Chains are separate debuffs, and can both be tethered to the same target without overriding each other.
Start with Q to mark the enemy, then dash onto them with W to trigger the mark. Finish with an auto attack
Cast Q, then immediately use mimic Q. Mimic Q activates the first mark and applies
For a complete rotation, use Q, mimic Q, W, then E. W activates a second mark, while E adds more damage and potential route.

Begin casting E, then immediately flash forward before the chain fires. This closes the distance during the cast, giving enemies almost no time to react. Follow with Q before the tether activates, allowing its delay damage to trigger the mark.
Use W flash and then mimic W. Because W was cast before flash, its return point remains far behind you, allowing Leblanc to cross an enormous distance before snapping all the way back to safety.
Her W and mimic W allow her to cross walls, cover huge distances, and return to safety after aggressive plays.
E also grants true sight, so enemies remain visible if they enter a brush or flash over a wall, helping you follow their escape.
Mimik E creates another chain. Time them to extend your crowd control or chain two different enemies during a fight.

Votre engagement consistera souvent à entrer dans la zone avec le Z puis votre E. Après un court délai, utilisez votre ultime E puis A. Une fois les deux immobilisations actives, attaquez ou revenez en arrière.
Votre combo à longue portée commence par votre ultime Z, puis votre E.
Si votre adversaire est à portée d'un combo A suivi d'un Z, c'est généralement une bonne option.
vous utilisez votre Z pour sauter sur la ligne arrière ennemie, souvent par-dessus les murs, pour éliminer une cible.
